To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) SVM is an appropriate classifier for the two sub‐tasks; (2) the combination of the features from the three feature sets is the most effective for the sub‐task A; (3) for the sub‐ task B, the features extracted from the tweet content are more important than the features from the tweet meta data; and (4) for the subtask B, the combination of the three feature sets and the weighting method of the probability output is the most effective.
(i) the use of features such as emoticons and hashtags is beneficial for both tasks, and (ii) the combination of multiple models is a useful strategy for both tasks.
(a) the performance of SVM-based sentiment classification can be improved through post-processing and (b) the performance of the system is sensitive to feature selection and parameter tuning.
